name: gh-review-comments
description: List, reply to, resolve, and create GitHub PR review comment threads

interface.shortDescription: Manage GitHub PR review threads with gh
interface.longDescription: Lists, replies to, resolves, and reopens GitHub pull request review threads, and creates reviews with line-level comments, through bundled gh CLI scripts.
defaultPrompt: Use $gh-review-comments to list unresolved review threads on this PR.
Use $gh-review-comments to reply to and resolve the review threads I fixed.
Use $gh-review-comments to create a review with inline comments on this PR.
